# Persona Runtime Spec

> Draft 0.1 of a runtime contract for loading personas and coordinating work through an agent harness. A persona is the versioned definition of a role or team. The runtime loads it and binds workspace resources. The harness runs the agent loop.

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/README.md): How personas, runtimes, and harnesses fit together.
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/specification.mdx): Folder structure, SKILL.md, definitions-only rule, resource keys, registry, and runtime rules.
- [Apps and connectors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/apps.mdx): Connector requirements, steps, lists, pipelines, app packages, live sync, and presence.
- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/examples.mdx): Studio tour and a prospect workflow from research to onboarding.
- [Terms and standards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/standards.mdx): Terminology, Agent Skills, MCP, A2A, and the Standard Agent Specification.

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): Format for the root SKILL.md and bundled skills.
